exact_missing_items: filtered query + paging + stable sort are required
export can retrieve more than the viewport, but normal browsing should stay slice-based
low-risk read-only inspection: allowed on refreshing, often stale, sometimes degraded
precise navigation/deep-linking: usually allowed if target object identity still valid
live mutation/approval/recovery/retry/cleanup: require current or direct canonical-runtime validation path
record export: concern, promotion, corroboration result, graph patch request/result, recovery record, exact ledger slice
bundle export: run evidence bundle, selected-object bundle, historical run package with manifest
view export: filtered ledger CSV/JSON, filtered concerns table, search results export, graph image/render
a canonical blocked event can still drive notification even if some projection surfaces are degraded
explicit search navigation to a historical run likely should update persisted Orchestrator focused-run state
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
